 iQOO Neo 12 runs Call of Duty Mobile at 185fps for over an hour
 By Rajesh Regmi - Oct 26, 2026 
 Advertisement
 Facebook Twitter ReddIt Copy URL 
 Add GIZMOCHINA on Google:
 Preferred Source 
 Prolific insider Digital Chat Station (DCS) has shared a gaming test of the iQOO Neo 12, claiming the phone supports more than 50 native 185fps games. The list includes most of the major mobile FPS titles, including Peacekeeper Elite, Delta Force, Valorant: Source Operation, CrossFire, Call of Duty Mobile, Counter-Strike: Future, Firefly, and Dark Zone.
 To back up the claim, DCS shared a PerfDog screenshot from a session of Call of Duty Mobile. The game ran at native 185fps with HD graphics for more than an hour and recorded an average of 185.05fps and a 1% low of 165.1fps.
 The 1% low measures the frame rate during the slowest 1% of frames, and it tells you more about how a match feels than the average does. Here, even the worst moments stayed well above 160fps. The screenshot also shows zero jank events across the run.
 iQOO Neo 12 runs COD at 185 FPS 
 Also Read The Best Gaming Phones in March 2026 
 DCS claims the iQOO Neo 12 is the first phone in the industry to run Call of Duty Mobile at 185fps with HD graphics. The test also covers only native 185fps gameplay at HD graphics settings, not the phone’s 2K mode, which combines super-resolution and frame interpolation.
 The results follow iQOO’s earlier announcements about the phone’s gaming capabilities. The company’s official teasers confirmed support for more than 50 native 185fps games, alongside an active cooling fan and a 2K 185Hz display.
 DCS also notes that iQOO has been working on the FPS experience for a while. Its ultra-sensitive touch zones and 4D game vibration already work in popular titles like Delta Force and Peacekeeper Elite. And native 185fps adds smoother frame rates on top, so you get touch, vibration, and smoothness together.
 Also Read OnePlus Nord CE 6 vs iQOO Z11 5G: Which Mid-Ranger Should You Buy in 2026? 
 Sustaining high frame rates for an extended period also puts the cooling system to the test. The iQOO Neo 12 comes with an Ice Dome active cooling fan, and it likely did its job well in the gaming test above.
 The iQOO Neo 12 will launch in China on October 28 and will be available for purchase right after.
